name: IC Analog — 3.3V, I2C — TSSOP
description: Cluster of surface-mount analog ICs featuring 3.3V operation, I2C communication, and TSSOP-10_3x3mm_P0.5mm footprints.
selection_hints: Select for analog IC applications operating at 3.3V with an I2C interface.
Use when PCB layout requires surface-mount TSSOP-10_3x3mm_P0.5mm footprint packaging.
Choose when using KiCad symbol tier A parts such as ADS1013IDGS, ADS1014IDGS, or ADS1015IDGS.
avoid_when: The circuit design requires a supply voltage other than 3.3V.
The application requires non-I2C bus communication or a non-analog IC function.
The board layout requires a footprint other than TSSOP-10_3x3mm_P0.5mm or through-hole mounting.
